source.note: The plan's own source (wave-1 row 21). The zip's License.txt (CC0) names the pack 'Cube Pets (2.0)' while the file is kenney_cube-pets_1.0.zip. Ingested through Blender, not via gltf: the gltf route stops with 'self is not defined' (three.js GLTFLoader cannot load the external Textures/colormap.png in Node), and would not flatten the single textured material anyway.
